# Apex Gym Website – Generated by AI

This repository contains a complete, production-ready gym website built using Tailwind CSS. It includes four pages: Home (index.html), About (about.html), Classes (classes.html), and Contact (contact.html). All styling is done with Tailwind utility classes. Background imagery uses the provided placeholder system for category-specific visuals.

How it’s organized
- index.html: Home page with hero, core programs, testimonials, and quick navigation.
- about.html: Our story, trainers, and facility tour.
- classes.html: Showcase of classes and weekly schedule.
- contact.html: Contact form and contact information.
- assets are referenced via placeholder image syntax: https://pixabay.com/get/g2dc64746c837ba7d286bd97cc0ec23c403f76920993102c89830982a2aa52e1e502f3e1c8f9994a6e9d77ae7aa0c59d084b5e915094343217f952a85a98c5aa2_640.jpg. For real deployments, replace with actual image URLs.

How to customize
- Change brand colors by editing the Tailwind color utilities (or swap to exact hex via arbitrary values like bg-[#DC143C]).
- Update hero background by replacing the image placeholder in the index.html hero section.
- Swap trainer portraits and class details in about.html and classes.html.
- Update contact information in all footers and header navigation as needed.

Accessibility and quality notes
- All pages use semantic HTML5 elements (header, nav, main, section, article, footer).
- Images include descriptive alt text.
- Fully responsive, mobile-first layout with accessible color contrast.
- Internal navigation is consistent across all pages.

Enjoy building your gym website! ✨
